main.description: Operations that have occured on a private git repo (since a given revision). This is just a nice-to-have, sources of truth are as always `com.atproto.sync.getRepo` and `getRecord` and `getBlocks`. This endpoint requires service auth from the knot side.

since.description: Request perations after this particular revision. Don't get it confused with pagination, use `cursor` for that.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response. This one takes priority over `since` when both are given.
Give as `cursor` to fetch the next page. This is left out when the response is at the newest operation.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: No such repo, or the caller can't get it for whatever reason.

errors.name: SinceTooOld
errors.description: The knot doesn't have operations back that far. Do a full `com.atproto.sync.getRepo` instead.

opEntry.description: A single op. If there are operations that have a same rev, it means they belong to the same commit. CID is null for deletes and prev is null for creates.

cid.description: Content ID of the record after the op.

prev.description: Content ID of the record before the op.
